ev-c84b98a7a0418dcc.title: HTML standard: server-sent events (paraphrase)
ev-c84b98a7a0418dcc.text: When an event stream contains an id field, the user agent stores it as the last event ID. If the connection drops, the EventSource reconnects automatically and sends the stored value in the Last-Event-ID request header, so the server can resume from that point. A retry field sets the reconnection delay in milliseconds.

ev-63f39eb50c9db43f.title: Engineering note: SSE in server frameworks
ev-63f39eb50c9db43f.text: Server frameworks generally support server-sent events by streaming a text/event-stream response. Starlette and FastAPI use a streaming response; Node.js servers write the headers and keep the response open. Replay is not automatic: the application must persist events with identifiers and read the Last-Event-ID header to send what the client missed.
